name: neurotensin receptor 1

function.text: NTSR1 encodes neurotensin receptor type 1. Annotated molecular activities include G protein-coupled receptor activity and G protein-coupled neurotensin receptor activity. It participates in temperature homeostasis and vocalization behavior.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Amphicrine-like carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
